meta.description: TEA H2 Scholar live voice plan. Boss mechanics follow the public TEA timeline with artificial phase-anchor gaps compressed into one continuous manual-timer reference. H2 Scholar follows the supplied Lv80 prog-safe plan: P1 Seraph and Hand Spreadlo, P1.5 LC recovery, P2 BJ/CC tank care and Photon recovery, P3 Inception/Wormhole/J-Wave, and P4 Fate Calibration/Almighty Judgment. All cues are enabled. Party DPS changes phase push timing, so Phase Sync or Pull Offset is recommended.
